intro.text: A hazard of Patji's jungle that Dusk takes care to avoid; whole fields of them grow in places.
A carnivorous plant of the Pantheon islands that hides behind a mucus disguise coloured like its surroundings and bites anything that strays within reach.

description.text: Its teeth reach the length of a human arm. When a creature comes within about four feet, it shoots out its jaws, bites, and holds on until the prey dies, then needs roughly an hour to reset.
Trappers look out for mounds rising from bare ground or rock, a telltale sign of a tokka.
